name: Nullframe Ghost Rig Shoulder Harness
description:
Over-jacket tactical harness in matte-black recycled ballistic nylon with grey ghost-stitching along the load-bearing channels. Four modular holster mounts — two chest, two flank — accept standard-format mag housings or custom inserts. A dorsal channel runs spine-length to accommodate spinal rig externals and neural port cable management.

Fits over most mid-weight jackets without bunching. Strap geometry adjusts via ceramic slide buckles that hold under 200kg of lateral pull. Popular with operatives who need to look like they're carrying nothing.
functionality: Four modular holster mounts configurable for sidearms, data-drives, medkits, or custom rigs. Dorsal channel routes spinal rig cables cleanly without snagging. Ceramic buckles are non-metallic — scanner-minimal. Collapses flat under a jacket without visible print.
what_it_says: You're prepared for something, and you'd rather the room not know what.
story_hooks: A specific mount configuration — left chest, right flank empty — is a known signal in certain Circuit circles that the wearer is available for hire.
Nullframe's ceramic buckles are non-metallic, but a recent Corpsec memo flags the harness's Dyneema channels as identifiable by millimeter-wave scan.
Someone was found wearing one with all four mounts loaded but no weapons — just sealed data canisters, all encrypted.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, minimalist tactical harness worn over the torso and shoulders. Creates a streamlined silhouette with strategic weight distribution across chest and flanks. The matte-black finish absorbs light, making the wearer appear almost shadowless in dim environments. Ghost-stitching creates subtle linear patterns that catch only at oblique angles. Projects competent, understated lethality.
physical_description.fit: Precision-engineered compression fit that conforms to the upper body without restricting movement. Sits snug against the ribs and shoulders, distributing load evenly. Adjustable strap geometry via ceramic buckles allows customization for different frame sizes and augmentation profiles. Designed to layer cleanly over mid-weight jackets without bulk or bunching.
physical_description.primary_material: Recycled ballistic nylon, matte-black finish. High-tensile synthetic weave rated for industrial-grade durability and abrasion resistance.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, slightly rubbery surface with subtle weave texture visible under close inspection. Ghost-stitching in grey creates raised linear ridges along load-bearing channels. Ceramic buckles are cool and slightly grippy to touch.
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte black primary with grey ghost-stitching accent lines running vertically down chest and flanks. All hardware (ceramic buckles, attachment points) in gunmetal grey or flat chrome.
physical_description.closures: Ceramic slide buckles on adjustable shoulder and flank straps. Modular quick-release connections on holster mounts for rapid reconfiguration. Dorsal channel uses friction-fit cable management clips.
distinctive_features: Four modular holster mounts (2 chest, 2 flank) with standard-format compatibility
Dorsal spine channel for spinal rig externals and neural port cable routing
Ghost-stitching in grey along all load-bearing channels for low-visibility design
Ceramic slide buckles engineered to hold 200kg lateral pull
Recessed attachment points that accept custom inserts
Cable management clips integrated into dorsal channel
Lightweight yet reinforced synthetic composite weave
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2-3 professional operative equipment. High-end enough to signal serious capability and investment, but deliberately understated to avoid drawing corpo-level attention.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by security contractors, independent operatives, black-market couriers, and anyone who needs tactical functionality without advertising their work. The 'ghost' aesthetic appeals to those who prefer anonymity over status signaling. Worn by both corpo-tier fixers and Tier 3 street operatives, depending on context.
physical_description.condition_typical: Maintained in pristine or near-pristine condition. The matte-black finish conceals minor scuffs and wear. Cables and attachment points are regularly inspected and recalibrated. Weathering would suggest heavy field use, which actually increases street credibility.
